description: This file defines a ChatControllerPool object that manages multiple AbortController instances for streaming chat messages, allowing adding, stopping, removing, and checking for pending controllers.

methods.name: addController
methods.description: Adds a new AbortController to the pool associated with a specific session and message IDs.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Aborts the controller associated with the given session and message IDs.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Aborts all controllers currently in the pool.

methods.name: hasPending
methods.description: Checks if there are any controllers currently pending (not aborted).

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the controller associated with the specified session and message IDs from the pool.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates a unique key string based on session ID and message ID.
